name: maps-holiday-entitlement-ui-tests
description: Playwright and Cucumber UI tests for the GOV.UK holiday entitlement calculator

scripts.test:local-accessibility: npm run allure:prepare && cross-env LOCAL_TAGS="@LOCAL-01 or @LOCAL-02 or @LOCAL-03 or @LOCAL-04" node scripts/run-local-suite.cjs
scripts.test:local:calculator: cross-env HEADLESS=true LOCAL_CALCULATOR=true LOCAL_TAGS=@local_calculator node scripts/run-local-suite.cjs
scripts.test:page-health:local: npm run allure:prepare && cross-env LOCAL_TAGS=@local_page node scripts/run-local-suite.cjs
scripts.test:smoke: npm run allure:prepare && cross-env LOCAL_TAGS="@local_smoke or (@local_page and @links)" node scripts/run-local-suite.cjs
scripts.test:local:all: npm run allure:prepare && cross-env LOCAL_TAGS="@local_app or @local_page" node scripts/run-local-suite.cjs
scripts.test:network: npm run allure:prepare && cucumber-js --tags "@requires_network and not @manual"
scripts.test:network:smoke: npm run allure:prepare && cucumber-js --tags "@requires_network and @smoke and not @manual"
scripts.test:browsers: npm run allure:prepare && node scripts/run-browser-matrix.cjs live
scripts.test:live:smoke: npm run allure:prepare && node scripts/run-browser-matrix.cjs smoke
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:steps && npm run check:routes && npm run check:gherkin && npm run test:unit && npm run lint && npm run format:check
